items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: August Russel was a trombone player whom I was trying to remember as being a part of the early band when I first joined.

ctx.x: Who was playing piano with them at that time?
Um, Alagretta Alexander, when I heard them, the first time I heard them was The Pianist Who's Dead Now. Maybe you know his name, Mr. Russell.
